## Loading Data & Packages

```{r, results='hide'}
# Data
GDL_raw <- read.csv("../data/raw/GDL/siniestralimap_2015-2025.csv")
GDL_dict <- read.csv("../data/raw/GDL/diccionario_siniestralimap_2015_2025.csv")

# Packages
#install.packages("pacman")
library(pacman)

```

## Exploratory Data Analysis 

The raw dataset contains **50,433 observations across 36 variables**. Every row
in the dataset is representative of an individual involved in a car crash. Since 
the original data is in spanish, we changed the variable names to english and 
set the appropriate data type for each variable.

```{r}
# Copy, rename, translate and prepare data ----

GDL_df <- GDL_raw %>%
  rename(
    record_number = consecutivo,
    crash_id = Id,
    crash_counter = contador_siniestro,
    date = fecha,
    year = anio,
    month = mes,
    day = dia,
    day_of_week = dia_sem,
    time_range = rango_hora,
    municipality = mun,
    street_1 = calle_1,
    street_2 = calle_2,
    longitude = x,
    latitude = y,
    intersection_coord = id_xy_int,
    crash_type = tipo_siniestro,
    user_condition = condicion_usuario,
    user_type = tipo_usuario,
    vehicle_involved = ibaen_atro,
    public_trans_jurisdiction = jurisdiccion_tp,
    sex = sexo,
    age_range = rango_edad,
    injury_severity = gravedad,
    outcome = consecuencia,
    is_fatality = dmuerto,
    is_injured = dherido,
    is_pedestrian = dpeaton,
    is_cyclist = dbici,
    is_motorcyclist = dmoto,
    is_other_vehicle = dotroveh,
    is_driver = dconductor,
    is_passenger = dpasajero,
    is_unknown_user = dileso,
    involved_persons = involucrados,
    year_month = mes_anio,
    injury_hierarchy = herido_jer
  ) %>%
  
  # Standardize unknown values
  mutate(across(where(is.character),
                ~ na_if(., "Desconocido"))) %>% # 'Desconocido' means 'Unkown'
  
  # Convert dates
  mutate(
    date = dmy(date),
    year_month = ym(year_month),
    day = as.integer(day),

    # Translate months
    month = recode(
      month,
      "Enero" = "January", "Febrero" = "February",
      "Marzo" = "March", "Abril" = "April",
      "Mayo" = "May", "Junio" = "June",
      "Julio" = "July", "Agosto" = "August",
      "Septiembre" = "September", "Octubre" = "October",
      "Noviembre" = "November", "Diciembre" = "December"
    ),

    # Translate days of the week
    day_of_week = recode(
      day_of_week,
      "Lunes" = "Monday", "Martes" = "Tuesday",
      "Miércoles" = "Wednesday", "Miercoles" = "Wednesday",
      "Jueves" = "Thursday", "Viernes" = "Friday",
      "Sábado" = "Saturday", "Sabado" = "Saturday",
      "Domingo" = "Sunday"
    ),

    # Translate crash_type
    crash_type = recode(
      crash_type,
      "Colision con objeto fijo" = "Collision with fixed object",
      "Colision con persona peatona" = "Collision with pedestrian",
      "Colision entre dos o mas vehiculos" = "Collision between two or more vehicles",
      "Otro" = "Other",
      "Caida de vehiculo" = "Fall from vehicle",
      "Caida al interior de un autobus" = "Fall inside a bus",
      "Colision con vehiculo estacionado" = "Collision with parked vehicle",
      "Derrape y/o volcadura" = "Skidding and/or rollover",
      "Caida al exterior del autobus" = "Fall from outside of a bus",
      "Colision con animal" = "Collision with animal"
    ),

    # Translate user_condition
    user_condition = recode(
      user_condition,
      "Peaton" = "Pedestrian",
      "Pasajero" = "Passenger",
      "Conductor" = "Driver"
    ),
    
    # Translate user_type
    user_type = recode(
      user_type,
      "Peaton" = "Pedestrian",
      "Vehiculo particular" = "Private vehicle",
      "Transporte empresarial/personal" = "Company/employee transport",
      "Transporte de carga" = "Freight transport",
      "Motociclista" = "Motorcyclist",
      "Transporte publico/pasajeros" = "Public/passenger transport",
      "Ciclista" = "Cyclist",
      "Otro vehiculo" = "Other vehicle",
      "Tren ligero" = "Light rail"
    ),

    # Translate vehicle_involved
    vehicle_involved = recode(
      vehicle_involved,
      "Otro vehiculo" = "Other vehicle",
      "Automovil" = "Car",
      "Van" = "Van",
      "Camioneta pickup/ carga ligera" = "Pickup/light-duty truck",
      "Motocicleta" = "Motorcycle",
      "Autobus" = "Bus",
      "Bicicleta" = "Bicycle",
      "Tren" = "Train",
      "Camion unitario" = "Single-unit truck",
      "Tractocamion" = "Tractor-trailer",
      "Tren ligero" = "Light rail",
      "Autobus articulado" = "Articulated bus",
      "Motocarro" = "Motorized tricycle",
      "Patin o scooter" = "Skateboard or scooter",
      "Suv o todoterreno" = "SUV or off-road vehicle",
      "Ciclomotor" = "Moped",
      "Otros vehiculos de baja potencia" = "Other low-powered vehicles"
    ),

    # Translate sex
    sex = recode(
      sex,
      "Hombre" = "Male",
      "Mujer" = "Female"
    ),

    # Translate injury_severity
    injury_severity = recode(
      injury_severity,
      "Traumatismo o lesion" = "Injury",
      "Traumatismo mortal" = "Fatal injury",
      "Sin traumatismo aparente en sitio" = "No apparent injury at scene"
    ),
    
    # Translate outcome
    outcome = recode(
      outcome,
      "Lesionado" = "Injured",
      "Fallecido" = "Deceased",
      "Ileso" = "Uninjured"
    ),

    # Convert categorical variables to factors
    month = factor(month, levels = month.name, ordered = TRUE),
    day_of_week = factor(
      day_of_week,
      levels = c("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday",
                 "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday")
    ),
    municipality = factor(municipality),
    time_range = factor(time_range),
    crash_type = factor(crash_type),
    user_condition = factor(user_condition),
    user_type = factor(user_type),
    vehicle_involved = factor(vehicle_involved),
    sex = factor(sex),
    age_range = factor(age_range),
    injury_severity = factor(injury_severity),
    outcome = factor(outcome),
    injury_hierarchy = factor(injury_hierarchy),
    
    # Convert dichotomous variables to factors
    across(
      c(crash_counter, is_fatality, is_injured, is_pedestrian, is_cyclist,
        is_motorcyclist, is_other_vehicle, is_driver,
        is_passenger, is_unknown_user),
      factor
    )
  )
```

Table 1. Dataset variable descriptions.

| Original | Translated | Type |           Description        |
|----------|------------|------| ---------------------------- |
| consecutivo | **record_number** | numeric | Record number |
| Id | **crash_id** | string | Unique crash id |
| contador_siniestro | **crash_counter** | binary | First (1) or repeated occurrence (0) |
| anio | **year** | integer | Year |
| fecha | **date** | date | Date of the crash in dd/mm/yyyy format |
| mes | **month** | category | Month in which the crash occurred |
| dia | **day** | integer | Numerical day of the month |
| dia_sem | **day_of_week** | string | Day of the week |
| rango_hora | **time_range** | string | Two-hour interval in which crash occurred |
| mun | **municipality** | string | Municipality containing nearest intersection |
| calle_1 | **street_1** | string | Name of the street where the crash occurred |
| calle_2 | **street_2** | string | Nearest intersecting street |
| x | **longitude** | Numeric | Longitude of the nearest intersection |
| y | **latitude** | Numeric | Latitude of the nearest intersection |
| id_xy_int | **intersection_coord** | string | Coordinates of the nearest intersection | 
| tipo_siniestro | **crash_type** | string | Type of road crash |
| condicion_usuario | **user_condition** | category | Role of the person involved |
| tipo_usuario | **user_type** | category | User classification |
| ibaen_atro | **vehicle_involved** | category | Type of vehicle involved in the crash |
| jurisdiccion_tp | **-** | - | Empty and not described in data dictionary | 
| sexo | **sex** | Character | Sex of the person involved.
| rango_edad | **age_range** | Character | Age range of the person involved |
| gravedad | **injury_severity** | Character | Severity of trauma resulting from the crash |
| consecuencia | **outcome** | Character | Injury classification |
| dmuerto | **is_fatality** | Integer | Indicates if  person involved died (1 = yes) |
| dherido | **is_injured** | Integer | Was person involved injured? (1 = yes) |
| dpeaton | **is_pedestrian** | Integer | Was person involved a pedestrian? (1 = yes) |
| dbici | **is_cyclist** | Integer | Was person involved a cyclist? (1 = yes) |
| dmoto | **is_motorcyclist** | Integer | Was person involved a motorcyclist? (1 = yes) |
| dotroveh | **is_other_vehicle** | Integer | Did person use another vehicle type? (1 = yes) |
| dconductor | **is_driver** | Integer | Was the person involved a driver? (1 = yes) |
| dpasajero | **is_passenger** | Integer | Was person involved a passenger? (1 = yes) |
| dileso | **is_unknown_user** | Integer | Was person involved uninjured? (1 = yes) |
| involucrados | **involved_persons** | Integer | Indicator of count of involved persons |
| mes_anio | **year_month** | Character | Month-year combination |
| herido_jer | **injury_hierarchy** | Character | Injury hierarchy |

```{r}
str(GDL_df)
```

First of all, we can delete the *jurisdiccion_tp* and *involved_persons* variables 
from the dataset, due to the former being completely empty and the later being all 
of class '1' (Fig. 1).

```{r fig.show="hold", out.width="49%", fig.align='center', fig.cap="Distribution of missing values across variables (left) and classification of involved\\_persons (right).", echo=FALSE}
missing_values(GDL_df)$bar_plot + labs(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL) 
plot_bar(GDL_df, "involved_persons")
```

```{r}
GDL_df$public_trans_jurisdiction <- NULL
GDL_df$involved_persons <- NULL
```

Every row in the dataset is representative of an individual involved in a crash. We can 
determine the number of **unique crashes** based on the *crash_id* variable. 

```{r eval=FALSE}
# Unique crashes and records
GDL_df %>%
  summarise(
    observations = n(),
    unique_crashes = n_distinct(crash_id),
    missing_crash_ids = sum(is.na(crash_id))
  ) %>%
  kable()
```

\begin{center}Table 2. Unique crashes vs total observations.\end{center}

```{r echo=FALSE}
# Unique crashes and records
GDL_df %>%
  summarise(
    observations = n(),
    unique_crashes = n_distinct(crash_id),
    missing_crash_ids = sum(is.na(crash_id))
  ) %>%
  kable()
```
